noun_definition: Inconsistency bug refers to the failure of the app to display the 'Go back to home screen' link on the 'Hmm its not here' page of archived workspace settings, despite it being present on other workspace pages.

noun: go back to home screen link
noun_definition: Go back to home screen link refers to a navigational element that should be present on the 'Hmm its not here' page of archived workspace settings, allowing users to return to the main screen of the app.
hmm its not here page refers to a specific page in the app's settings that is displayed when a workspace has been archived and does not contain the 'Go back to home screen' link.

Archived workspace setting refers to the configuration or state of a workspace that has been deleted but is still accessible through a specific link, which should display a consistent user interface element, namely the 'Go back to home screen' link.
